component.name: Sqyre
component.summary: Desktop macro builder with screen-aware automation

description.p: Sqyre is a desktop app for building and running macros without writing code. Each macro is a tree of actions: loops and branches for flow control, detection steps when the screen matters, and leaf actions for mouse and keyboard input.

Image Search, OCR, and Find Pixel use PureCV and Tesseract. On Wayland, capture and synthetic input go through xdg-desktop-portal (ScreenCast / RemoteDesktop) and PipeWire where the session supports them.

Flatpak data lives under ~/.var/app/com.sqyre.app/.sqyre (via --persist), separate from native or AppImage ~/.sqyre. Updates: use flatpak update or your software center — in-app self-replace is not supported for Flatpak.
